runtime_benchmark.scope: CPU warm calls over cached eight feature rows; excludes RGB/perception/feature extraction, transport, queues and ROS. Not end-to-end FPS.

source_stamp_sensitivity.scope: Collector source file changed after this process had loaded it. Per-run source snapshot retained; mutable completion source stamp differs. Descriptive exclusion sensitivity only; frozen selection/model artifacts unchanged.

master_inventory.scope: Canonical complete rows only. No raw/source files moved or deleted; partial/pilot raw captures remain quarantined. Thinned scientific cohort indices remain separate. New nested followup paths rebased to the supplied common data root.

environment.scope: Frozen previous official e-means centers; coarse groups merge centers using RGB geometry only. No semantic weather labels used online.

secondary_expected_deficit.scope: Secondary policy frozen after primary results and before supported-road quality scoring. No refit, no replacement of original primary test/policy; descriptor selection only from calibration OOF.

secondary_uncertainty_ablation.scope: Fixed identical task weights compare posterior integration against mean-only ablation and matched RF multi-target means. No claim of uncertainty benefit unless this ablation supports it; no model/policy selection.

probability_saturation.scope: Descriptive primary-test observation motivating a secondary expected-deficit candidate; original policy remains unchanged.

fresh_confirmation.scope: Fresh confirmation: prior supported cohort retired into v2 calibration; no fitting here.

confirmation_adoption.scope: Same-map conditional road confirmation. Diagnostic gates do not establish every spatial class, environment-specific failure truth, independent-map validity or perception retraining gain.
